speaker: Old Farmer
text: Bandits on the king's own road... it wasn't like this when I was young. The land's been restless since the wardstones went quiet, you mark me.

speaker: Old Farmer
text: Listen — I watched them come. Their chief keeps to his camp and won't budge from it. Cowards fight bravest behind a fence, so pull his dogs to you a few at a time before you go knocking.

speaker: Old Farmer
text: And keep your feet on the road where it's dry, and your archers out of the trees' shade. An old man sees these things.
